source.title: The Mysterious Merchant
source.description:
Well met again, <name>. Shaw and his spies have provided us with information on a mysterious merchant who just arrived in Kalimdor and is looking to offload a collection of dangerous artifacts. We've come to believe that he has an Echoing Orb in his collection. He is staying at the Theramore Inn in Dustwallow Marsh. Travel quickly, retrieve the orb, and speak to no one of this. We are sending you in alone to avoid drawing the attention of our enemies.

Be safe, and go with the light.
source.objective: Travel to Theramore and find the mysterious merchant.
source.completion: Ah, you made it! Katherine sent me to assist you in your mission. We must hurry though, our quarry has escaped!
